blm: Bureau of Land Management surface. Not a survey. Check the local office before you rely on it.
usfs: USDA Forest Service ownership. Not a survey. Check the local office before you rely on it. This is not permission to enter.
usfs_inholding: Inside a national-forest administrative boundary, but mapped as non-Forest Service. Do not assume you may enter.
usfs_other: Mapped inside a national forest, but not as Forest Service ownership. Do not assume you may enter. Not a survey.
state_trust: New Mexico State Trust land. Not federal public land. Recreational access generally needs a State Land Office permit, and the permit does not open every tract.
unknown: No open dataset covers this point. It may be private, tribal, or missing. This app is not permission to enter.
tribal: Tribal or Pueblo land. Access is not implied. This is not a survey and not permission to enter.
nps: National Park Service legislated boundary. NPS does not necessarily own every parcel inside it. Not a survey and not permission to enter.
federal_other: Federal surface. Not a survey and not permission to enter.
dod: Department of Defense surface. Access is not implied. Not a survey and not permission to enter.
state_other: State land in this dataset. Not federal public land. Not a survey and not permission to enter.
abq_open: City of Albuquerque Open Space, mapped as open to the public. Not a survey and not permission to ignore posted rules.
abq_closed: City of Albuquerque Open Space mapped as closed to the public. Do not assume you may enter. Not a survey.
local_protected: Local or private protected area in the public dataset. Not a survey and not permission to enter.
private_mapped: Mapped as private. No owner name is included. This is not a survey and not permission to enter.
sma_undefined: Surface-management class is undefined here. Do not assume you may enter. Not a survey.
pub_oa: PAD-US public-access value: open. That is not permission to enter.
pub_ra: PAD-US public-access value: restricted. That is not permission to enter.
pub_xa: PAD-US public-access value: closed. That is not a live closure notice, and it is not permission to enter.
pub_uk: PAD-US public-access value: unknown. Do not assume you may enter.
closures: Live closures, fire restrictions, and seasonal gates are not in this pack.
trail_untagged: Access is not tagged. A missing access tag is not permission to enter or to leave the trail.
not_a_survey: Boundaries are not a survey. GPS error can put this dot on the wrong side of a fence.
trespass: This app does not grant access. Private land, Pueblo and other tribal land, leased or closed trust land, and posted trails are not opened by a polygon. If the dataset is silent, the answer is unknown.
mass_footnote: Mass and confession times appear only when an OpenStreetMap tag has them. The value is shown raw. This app does not scrape parish sites.
